purpose: Construct a complete, partial, or empty opaque state-candidate record without defining a scientific state space.

required.statement: Validate every supplied component identifier and opaque value carrier before successful publication.
Preserve every supplied key/value pair, exposed mapping order, per-component provenance, unresolved items, and reservations.
Accept complete, partial, and empty mappings; omitted components remain absent and completeness remains unasserted.
Expose no successful partial result after validation or preservation failure.

forbidden.statement: Do not invent a missing component, default value, completeness claim, explicit state type, or state space.
Do not infer an initial state, terminal state, transition, trajectory, or scientific evaluation from equation-bearing components.
Do not mutate supplied keys, values, or external scientific state.

deferred.statement: Scientific classification of candidate components and explicit state-space semantics remain preserved unresolved.
Future state and transition execution requires separate scientific authority.

operations.purpose: Return an immutable keyed candidate record with no state-space or completeness claim.

inputs.name: components
inputs.semantic_role: complete, partial, or empty mapping of covered scientific-object IDs to opaque values

constraints.statement: Every key must be one of the twelve covered scientific-object identifiers.
Every value must preserve the OpaqueValue carrier and payload.

fields.name: components
fields.semantic_role: preserved complete, partial, or empty component mapping

constraints.statement: Every supplied component remains present and unchanged; omitted components remain absent.

preconditions.statement: Every component key is in the covered identifier set.
Every component value preserves the OpaqueValue carrier.

postconditions.statement: Every supplied key/value pair is retained exactly and exposed order is preserved.
Omitted components remain absent and no default is created.
Completeness remains unasserted and state-space membership remains undefined.
No explicit state, initial state, terminal state, or transition is created.

invariants.statement: Each component remains opaque, distinct, and addressable by its stable scientific-object identifier.
Partial-candidate status and all eleven unresolved identifiers remain visible.

steps: validate component identifiers and opaque value carriers
preserve supplied key value pairs and exposed order
construct a candidate record with completeness unasserted and state space undefined
attach per-component traceability unresolved items and reservations

partial_order.before: validate component identifiers and opaque value carriers
preserve supplied key value pairs and exposed order
construct a candidate record with completeness unasserted and state space undefined
attach per-component traceability unresolved items and reservations

prescription_basis: Validation, exact mapping preservation, explicit unasserted status, and atomic publication are observable; the internal construction order is not otherwise prescribed.

error_contract.condition: A component key is outside the twelve covered scientific-object identifiers.
The component mapping or a component value does not preserve its declared carrier shape.
An explicit state space, completeness claim, default, state classification, initial or terminal state, or transition semantics are requested.

maximum_input_size.value: At most twelve distinct covered component keys

implementation_modes.statement: Expose complete, partial, and empty candidate records with stable errors.
Do not define a state space, completeness, defaults, or transitions.
Internal architecture remains free when observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: A state candidate is not promoted to a scientifically explicit state.
Keys, opaque values, exposed order, traceability, unresolved preservation, and failure atomicity cannot be weakened.

dependencies.purpose: Complete, partial, or empty component mapping

notes: Conformance is structural and does not establish an explicit scientific state model.
